decisions.reason: Having remained on the market into a second full cycle in the firm's core footwear category, the line is likely to stay unless its results now fall clearly below aspiration levels.

The supportive insole is still more vulnerable because accessories are easier to rationalise and can overlap with other insoles, but its survival after the first pruning suggests it remains above the cut-off for now.
The ergonomic safety-shoe series combines strong strategic fit with visible managerial commitment, so a large firm with slack would usually keep it unless performance disappoints markedly.
As a flagship insole tied to the firm's innovation direction, it would typically be protected and developed further rather than withdrawn after only two years.
